name: The Shops at Stone Bridge
summary: The Shops at Stone Bridge is a 155,000 square foot open-air community center located at Route 10 and I-691 in Cheshire, Connecticut. Developed as part of the Stone Bridge Crossing master-planned community, it features a diverse mix of retail, dining, medical, fitness, and service tenants serving the affluent surrounding area.
demographics: The Shops at Stone Bridge serves the affluent Cheshire, Connecticut community and surrounding areas along the Route 10 corridor. The primary trade area attracts upper-middle-income families with household incomes significantly above the state median, typically ranging from $100,000 to $150,000+. The shopper base consists predominantly of homeowners aged 35-65 in the master-planned Stone Bridge Crossing development and nearby established neighborhoods, with a strong preference for convenience-oriented shopping and quality dining options. The center draws professionals and families seeking everyday necessities combined with specialty retail in a modern, accessible open-air format.
description: The Shops at Stone Bridge is a modern 155,000 square foot shopping center strategically located at the intersection of Route 10 and I-691 in Cheshire, Connecticut. Developed by Regency Centers as a ground-up project, this open-air community center serves as the retail cornerstone of the master-planned Stone Bridge Crossing development. The center offers a carefully curated mix of national retailers, local merchants, dining establishments, and service providers including restaurants, salons, medical spaces, and fitness facilities. With its convenient location at a major highway interchange, The Shops at Stone Bridge provides easy accessibility for residents throughout the greater Cheshire area and neighboring communities. The property exemplifies Regency Centers' commitment to creating thriving neighborhood destinations that combine everyday convenience with quality shopping and dining experiences in an attractive, well-maintained environment.
